comparison.objective: Open a robot-vacuum brush door by releasing its catch; candidate separates finishing media from washers through a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneous button squeeze and hinged-door lifting versus bimanual pouring, screen agitation, granular-flow control, and reseating.
comparison.success_condition: Door ≥80° open, vacuum stable, hands clear for 1 s versus ≥98% media recovery, every washer retained, no loss/damage, screen released for 3 s.
comparison.reason: The tested mechanism and outcome are unrelated; no material rubric details needed for comparison are missing.
